learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to economically evaluate process engineering processes by applying operational and investment cost methods.
Students are able to apply a holistic process understanding to represent and further develop plants in reality and in-silico.

syllabus_topics: Independent development of an exemplary process in group work
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon passing the module examination. The grade contributes to the final grade weighted by credit points.
